en.title: Plumbing, MEP & Fire Protection Engineers – Kaohsiung (5 male)
description: Install plumbing, mechanical and electrical, and fire protection systems on construction projects. Fixed morning shift.
requirements: Male, ages 25–40, in good health, not color-blind.
Basic Mandarin is required.
Basic experience in plumbing and electrical work, mechanical and electrical work, or welding is preferred.
benefits: Currently plenty of overtime (about 2 hours per day, including weekends).
The company helps arrange dormitory housing; workers pay their own utilities. Lunch provided. Allowance based on ability.
Paid on the 10th of each month. 3-year contract, renewable.

zh.title: 高雄水電、機電、消防工程師（男5名）
description: 負責營建工程的水電、機電及消防系統施工，固定早班。
requirements: 男性，25至40歲，身體健康，無色盲。
須具備基本中文能力。
具水電、機電或焊接基本經驗者優先。
benefits: 目前加班多（每天約2小時，含週末）。
公司協助安排宿舍，水電費由員工自付。提供午餐。津貼依能力核定。
每月10日發薪。合約3年，可續約。

en.title: MEP Engineers for Construction Projects – Taiwan (20 male)
description: Install and build electrical, water supply and drainage, and mechanical and electrical systems for construction projects.
Assist with installing piping and mechanical and electrical equipment; read drawings, check progress and quality; coordinate with teams on site.
requirements: Male, with a vocational, college or university degree in mechanical and electrical, electrical, construction or a related field.
Experience in construction mechanical and electrical or plumbing and electrical work. Ability to read technical drawings is an advantage.
Basic Mandarin and good health preferred.
benefits: Mostly day shifts. Overtime is paid according to Taiwan regulations.
The company helps arrange housing, with a dormitory fee deducted. Meals are at your own expense.
Insurance and taxes follow Taiwan regulations.

zh.title: 臺灣各地工程機電（M&E）工程師（男20名）
description: 負責工程的電力、給排水及機電系統施工與安裝。
協助安裝管線及機電設備；閱讀圖面、檢查進度與品質；與現場各施工班組配合。
requirements: 男性，具機電、電機、營建或相關科系中專、專科或大學學歷。
具工程機電、水電經驗。會看技術圖面者佔優勢。
具基本中文能力、身體健康者優先。
benefits: 以日班為主。加班依臺灣法規計算。
公司協助安排住宿，並扣除宿舍費。伙食自理。
保險與稅款依臺灣法規辦理。

en.title: Plumbing & Electrical, Construction Engineers – Kaohsiung (10 male)
description: Carry out plumbing and electrical work on construction sites; manage work crews and supervise construction. Mostly on-site work.
requirements: Male, height 1.63 m or taller, weight under 80 kg.
Degree in mechanical, electrical or construction.
Plumbing and electrical experience is required.
Basic conversational Mandarin (can be learned while the application is being processed).
benefits: Fixed day shift, average overtime about 30 hours/month.
Free dormitory. Meals at your own expense.

zh.title: 高雄水電、營建工程師（男10名）
description: 負責工地水電作業；管理施工班組、監督工程。以現場工作為主。
requirements: 男性，身高163公分以上，體重80公斤以下。
機械、電機或營建科系畢業。
須具水電經驗。
具基本中文會話能力（可在辦理申請期間學習）。
benefits: 固定日班，平均每月加班約30小時。
免費宿舍。伙食自理。

en.title: Elevator Installation & Maintenance Engineers – Taiwan (4–5 male)
description: Install, build, maintain and finish elevator systems at construction projects (Taipei, Taichung, Kaohsiung).
requirements: Male, under 45.
University graduate (2 years of experience) or college/vocational graduate (5 years of experience).
Elevator installation experience. Mandarin or English preferred.
Good health, hardworking, good teamwork.
benefits: Reference income about NT$40,000–60,000/month (depends on overtime). Overtime pays NT$270 per hour; exact figures follow the employment contract.
Free, fully equipped dormitory. Utilities and meals at your own expense.
3-year contract, renewable.

zh.title: 臺灣各地電梯安裝、維修工程師（男4至5名）
description: 負責各工程案場的電梯系統安裝、施工、維修及收尾（臺北、臺中、高雄）。

大學畢業（具2年經驗）或專科／中專畢業（具5年經驗）。
具電梯安裝經驗。會中文或英文者優先。
身體健康、勤奮、善於團隊合作。
benefits: 參考月收入約新台幣40,000至60,000元（視加班而定）。加班費每小時新台幣270元；確切金額以勞動契約為準。
免費宿舍，設備齊全。水電費及伙食自付。
合約3年，可續約。

en.title: Elevator Installation Engineers – Taipei (5–7 male)
description: Install, build and assist in finishing elevator systems at construction projects.
requirements: Male, under 40.
University graduate (2+ years of experience) or college/vocational graduate (5+ years of experience).
Knows Mandarin or has elevator installation experience.
Good health, hardworking, good teamwork.
benefits: Reference take-home pay about NT$50,000/month (depends on overtime). Overtime is paid per job; exact figures follow the employment contract.
Dormitory fee NT$2,500/month, utilities about NT$1,000/month. Meals at your own expense.
3-year contract.

zh.title: 臺北電梯安裝工程師（男5至7名）
description: 負責各工程案場的電梯系統安裝、施工，並協助收尾。
requirements: 男性，40歲以下。
大學畢業（2年以上經驗）或專科／中專畢業（5年以上經驗）。
會中文或具電梯安裝經驗。
身體健康、勤奮、善於團隊合作。
benefits: 參考實領月薪約新台幣50,000元（視加班而定）。加班依工作內容以承包方式計酬；確切金額以勞動契約為準。
宿舍費每月新台幣2,500元，水電費每月約新台幣1,000元。伙食自理。
合約3年。

en.title: Civil Construction, Formwork & Tiling Engineers – Taiwan (10 male)
description: Carry out construction work, formwork and tiling. People with site management experience are preferred.
requirements: Male, with construction experience.
Knowing formwork and tiling and holding a car driver's license are advantages.
Working hours 08:00–17:00.
benefits: Average overtime about 20 hours/month. Opportunity to take on contract work.
NT$2,500/month deducted for room and board. Lunch provided; dinner provided for evening overtime.
3-year contract.

zh.title: 臺灣各地營造、模板、貼磚工程師（男10名）
description: 負責工程施工、模板及貼磚作業。具工地管理經驗者優先。

會做模板、貼磚，並持有汽車駕照者佔優勢。

每月扣除食宿費新台幣2,500元。提供午餐；晚上加班提供晚餐。
合約3年。

en.title: Road & Landscape Construction – Kaohsiung, Pingtung (4 male)

description: Cleanup, flagging and construction on building projects: roads, bridges and roadways, water conservancy and landscaping.
requirements: Holds the qualifications needed to process an engineer visa.
Knowing Mandarin is an advantage. Day shift.
benefits: Paid every 2 weeks (on the 5th and 20th of each month). Overtime follows Taiwan's labor law.
Dormitory arranged at your own expense. Lunch and drinking water provided on work days.
3-year contract.

zh.title: 高雄、屏東道路、水利、景觀工程師（男4名）

requirements: 具備辦理工程師簽證所需的學歷資格。
會中文者佔優勢。日班。

宿舍自理。上工日提供午餐及飲用水。
合約3年。

en.title: Groundwater & Plumbing Engineers – Taipei, New Taipei (5 male)
description: Carry out groundwater treatment, plumbing and electrical work, and related tasks.
requirements: Some Mandarin.
Plumbing and electrical experience preferred.
benefits: Expected at least 25 work days/month, overtime NT$266 per hour. Labor insurance and health insurance provided; details follow the employment contract.
Free housing with no room and board deduction; one person per room. Meals at your own expense, and the company gives a NT$3,000/month meal allowance.
Holders of a driver's license who agree to drive receive an extra NT$2,000/month allowance.
3-year contract. Pay increases gradually with experience and ability.

zh.title: 臺北、新北地下水處理、水電工程師（男5名）

具水電經驗者優先。
benefits: 預計每月至少25個工作日，加班費每小時新台幣266元。提供勞保及健保；詳情以勞動契約為準。
免費住宿，不扣食宿費；每人一間房。伙食自理，公司每月補助伙食費新台幣3,000元。
持有駕照並同意開車者，每月另加津貼新台幣2,000元。
合約3年。薪資依經驗及能力逐步調升。

en.title: Interior Fit-out Trades – New Taipei (22 male)

5 construction painters (no experience required).
5 drywall workers: partitions and drywall ceilings (no experience required).
2 carpenters: interior construction and installation (experience required).
5 masons/plasterers: wall plastering and tiling (experience required).
Work on projects across Taiwan.
requirements: Male, ages 25–45, height 1.60 m or taller, vocational school graduate or above.
Relevant work experience (as required for each position).
benefits: Overtime depends on workload.
Dormitory fee of NT$2,500/month deducted. Lunch provided by the employer.
3-year contract, renewable.

zh.title: 新北室內裝修工程師：焊接、油漆、石膏板（男22名）

工程油漆工5名（無需經驗）。

en.title: Construction & Concrete Pouring Engineers – Taipei (4 male)

Free dormitory. Lunch provided.
3-year contract.

zh.title: 臺北營造、澆置混凝土工程師（男4名）

身體健康、吃苦耐勞，適合在工地工作。

免費宿舍。提供午餐。
合約3年。

en.title: CNC & Stamping Die Engineers – Miaoli (2 male)

Products: precision stamped metal parts and molds.

benefits: 22 work days/month. Overtime about 40–80 hours/month; rate negotiated at interview.
Rotating shifts (morning shift at 8:00, mid shift at 13:00). Lunch provided.
Off-site housing: the agency helps find it, and workers pay for it themselves.

產品：精密金屬沖壓件、模具。

具基本中文或英文溝通能力。
會操作、保養CNC工具機或更換沖床模具。

宿舍在外住宿，由仲介協助尋找，員工自行負擔。

食宿自理。合約3年。
